newsitem.title: UK: Vendome buys Swiss watchmaker Vacheron.
newsitem.headline: Vendome buys Swiss watchmaker Vacheron.

text.p: Luxury goods maker Vendome said on Thursday that it has bought the world's oldest watchmaker Vacheron Constantin, based in Geneva, from former Saudi oil minister Sheik Ahmed Zaki Yamani.
Vendome, whose brands include Cartier, Piaget and Dunhill, declined to say how much it had paid.

It said in a statement that Vacheron, founded in 1755, would strengthen Vendome's position at the top end of the luxury watch market and Yamani, which has been majority shareholder at Vacheron since 1987 would "maintain his close friendship with the company."
Vendome is 70 percent owned by South African-controlled Richemont Securities and was created three years ago from the rationalisation of Richemont AG, Dunhill Holdings and Rothmans International.
